text:
alex: Quick ping — PR ready for review: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4567. It's a small change to batching/rate-limiter config that touches runtime routing and infra autoscaler. Need runtime + platform + infra eyes, and security for KMS header ordering. Can someone triage?

maya: @alex can you paste the config diff inline? Also what's the expected perf delta?

alex: sure — short snippet below. Perf looks like ~3-5% CPU p50 improvement in our microbench, but might change burst shapes.
```yaml
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  latency_target_ms: 60
rate_limiter:
  burst: 300
  refill_qps: 50
routing:
  prefer_local_shards: true
```

alex: TL;DR: reduces small-batch overhead, could increase short-tail bursts.

ravi: happy to take runtime. I'll run it against nightly perf and leave comments. @alex can you add a unit test around kv-cache interaction so I can validate?

jen: security: need a short note on KMS header ordering — does this change auth header canonicalization or ordering of signed headers? if so please add to the PR description and call out threat model.

sam: infra flagging @ops-team — autoscaler might need a scaling-policy tweak if burstiness goes up. Also what do you want for a deploy window?

alex: aiming for a canary tomorrow 10:00 PT, small rollout. Adding unit test + security note now.

deploy-bot: CI green — all checks passed. :white_check_mark:

maya: i'll look after lunch and sanity-check routing permutations. If anything weird I’ll post notes.

ravi: started perf run against nightly images, ETA ~2h.

jen: if you add a 1-paragraph security rationale i'll review after ravi's run.

alex: updated PR: added kv-cache unit test, security rationale, and canary plan (steps + rollback). link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4567#updated

maya: LGTM from platform side pending runtime sign-off :+1:

ravi: small nit — null-safety in kv mock, pushed fix and left lgtm.

alex: thanks all — merging after canary if no regressions. :rocket:
